    hund4 = N // 400
    leap = N >> 2
    ordd = N - leap 
    if (hund1): 
        ordd += hund1 
        leap -= hund1

def calculate_polygons(startx, starty, endx, endy, radius):
    sl = (2 * radius) * math.tan(math.pi / 6)
    p = sl * 0.5
    b = sl * math.cos(math.radians(30))
    w = b * 2
    h = 2 * sl   
    startx = startx - w
    starty = starty - h
    endx = endx + w
    endy = endy + h
    origx = startx
    origy = starty
    xoffset = b
    yoffset = 3 * p
    polygons = []
    row = 1
    counter = 0
    while starty < endy:
        if row % 2 == 0:
            startx = origx + xoffset
        else:
            startx = origx
        while startx < endx:
            p1x = startx
            p1y = starty + p
            p2x = startx
            p2y = starty + (3 * p)
            p3x = startx + b
            p3y = starty + h
            p4x = startx + w
            p4y = starty + (3 * p)
            p5x = startx + w
            p5y = starty + p
            p6x = startx + b
            p6y = starty
            poly = [
                (p1x, p1y),
                (p2x, p2y),
                (p3x, p3y),
                (p4x, p4y),
                (p5x, p5y),
                (p6x, p6y),
                (p1x, p1y)]
            polygons.append(poly)
            counter += 1
            startx += w
        starty += yoffset
        row += 1
    return polygons
